description: This file is a PHP source file implementing a compatibility driver for IBM DB2 and Oracle databases within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It defines a class for handling DB2/Oracle-specific behavior and a function for remapping bind variables.

classes.name: ADODB_db2oci
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_db2 to provide DB2/Oracle compatibility, including custom parameter handling and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_db2oci
classes.description: A record set class specific to the ADODB_db2oci driver, extending ADORecordSet_db2.

methods.name: _colonparser
methods.description: A function that remaps colon-prefixed bind variables in SQL statements to question marks, suitable for Oracle compatibility, handling comments and quoted strings.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Returns the parameter placeholder string, prefixed with ':' for named parameters.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves table names from the database with optional filtering by table type and schema.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes SQL statements, applying colon variable remapping if necessary.
